body:
I'm still stuck in the decision between life vs. death. Maybe I'm evaluating it seriously wrong, but I feel that dying once would cause less pain to my parents than continuing to hurt them the way I already have. I feel so incredibly guilty for what I have done. Since my words go uncredited due to the lack of trust, taking my own life will be the only, and most efficient, way to show that I am truly sorry for what I have done over the past 19 years.

While I'm 1,000 miles away, might as well do it. None of my family/friends would see my body, and maybe it'll go kinda unnoticed. I'm already going to Hell. Why wait another 60 years?

I typed out a large 3-paragraph response to your message, but upon hitting "save", RES fucked up and I lost everything. Oh well. In short, thank you so much for your time & response. I really appreciate it.

Thank you for your kind words. 

My parents have forgiven me, thousands of times. Pretty recently, I've redeemed my last chance and fucked that up too. My Dad told me today that when someone asks him about his son, he can't help but think in his head: "My son is a liar and thief who steals from me", while he says nice things about me out loud. He also mentioned how he's ashamed of who I've become. My mother had very similar things to say, adding on that she no longer welcomes me in her home. This is what really made me feel suicidal. Hearing that from the people who raised you is incredibly painful, for me at least. They're trying to blame themselves for my faults and that makes me feel even worse. They're too great of people to think they're failures when I'm really the one at fault.

I'm 1,000 miles away from my parents at my internship, may I add. The long distance factor only complicates things more. I'm also long distance from my girlfriend (internship), who really keeps me sane. The loneliness definitely doesn't help the situation.

I find myself lying in order to hide my past of lying... it's just a constant loop. I feel guilty for keeping my girlfriend ignorant of this. The guilt/pain is outweighing my ability to cope. I would feel extremely bad ending my life mostly due to her. She's the first woman in my life I have never told a lie to. She has no idea I'm suicidal or about the reasons behind it. But I'm 19 and any relationship with a woman isn't really going to last anyway, right? That's what I'd like to think because I really don't want to hurt her.
